name: Ant-Man

abilityDetails.Power Sting: Rakip özel saldırı attığında yüksek şok hasarı almasını sağlar.
abilityDetails.Unsteady: Gelen saldırılar belirtilen olasılıkla pasif olarak Sıyırma (Glancing) olur.
abilityDetails.Poison: Zamanla zehir hasarı verir ve iyileşme etkilerini %30 azaltır.
abilityDetails.Petrify: Düşmanın iyileşme ve güç kazanım hızını azaltır.

howToPlay: Ant-Man için oynanış rehberi: Özel saldırılarını kullanarak rakiplerini alt edin. Komboları düzgün zamanlayarak siper alın.
bestUse: Bu şampiyon genel maceralarda ve Science sınıfı avantajı olan yollarda en iyi performansı gösterir.

abilitySections.title: Passive
content: Ant-Man is Immune to Poison and Shock effects.

abilitySections.title: Pym Particle - Max 9
content: Ant-Man is immune to Buffs. Whenever he would, he instead generates 1 Pym Particle.

Whenever Ant-Man's basic attacks intercept the opponent, or strikes them when recovering from a Heavy, he consumes 1 Pym Particle to refresh any personal Fatigue, Poison, and Power Sting Debuffs on the opponent.

abilitySections.title: Power Sting
content: If Ant-Man has 3 or more Pym Particles, landing a Heavy Attack or being knocked down by a Special Attack consumes 3 Pym Particles to inflict 1 Power Sting Debuff on the opponent lasting 9 second(s). An opponent with Power Sting takes [10,266] Direct Damage if they activate a Special Attack.
Whenever Ant-Man's personal Power Stings detonate, they also deal a burst of [1,539.9] Physical Damage for each Debuff on the opponent including the Power Sting.

abilitySections.title: Special Attacks
content: Whenever Ant-Man activates a Special Attack the opponent is inflicted with a non-stacking 100% Unsteady Debuff lasting 15 seconds. Unsteady cannot be activated if the opponent is already under the effect of an Unsteady Debuff.
When Unsteady expires this ability goes on a 15 second cooldown before it can be activated again.

abilitySections.title: Champion Attacks
content: While under the effect of personal Unsteady Debuffs, Ant-Man Cannot Miss his Opponent.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: On activation gain 3 Pym Particles. Then, if Ant-Man has 9 Pym Particles, this Special Attack is Unblockable.
Each hit inflicts a Fatigue Debuff lowering the opponent's Crit Rating by [144.74] for 15 second(s). Max Stacks 12.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: Each Pym Particle Grants Ant-Man +[2,566.5] Attack Rating for the duration of this Attack. Consume all Pym Particles at the end of the Special Attack.

On the second hit, consume all Fatigue Debuffs on the opponent. For each Fatigue consumed, the opponent is inflicted with a Poison Debuff that deals [7,699.5] damage over 15 second(s) and reduces their health recovery by 30%. Max Stacks 12.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: Inflict a Petrify Debuff reducing the potency of Power Gain and Regeneration effects by 10% for 20 second(s). The potency of this Petrify increases by 10% for each Debuff active on the opponent.
